challenge: Hacktoberfest 2026 Open-Source AI Challenge: Week 1 - Touch Grass

steps.action: Eliminate smartphone glare and screen dependency during outdoor hikes. Design a 'Pocket-First' architecture with tactile controls and audio whispers.
Selected Google Gemma 2 (9B-IT) for backcountry survival and Leave-No-Trace reasoning, and Prior Labs TabPFN for zero-shot microclimate tabular forecasting.
Implemented Web Audio FFT spectral decomposition matching harmonic footprints of Hermit Thrush, Wood Duck, Red-tailed Hawk, and Barred Owl without network roundtrips.
Integrated ElevenLabs speech synthesis for natural earbud whispers with automatic offline Web Speech API fallback for deep wilderness canyons.
Engineered Arduino UNO Q C++ firmware with BME280 sensor and Qualcomm AI Hub quantization support for real-time backpack telemetry.
